
Check readiness, versions and configured capabilities

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:57038/health
{"status":"ok"}
$ curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:57038/version > version.json

$ jq . version.json
{
  "conda-presto": "0.8.1.dev71+g7646e42af.d20260924",
  "conda": "26.5.3",
  "conda-rattler-solver": "0.1.1",
  "conda-lockfiles": "0.2.1",
  "conda-workspaces": "0.10.0",
  "conda-sboms": "0.3.0",
  "conda-sigstore": "0.1.2"
}

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:57038/capabilities > capabilities.json

$ jq . capabilities.json
{
  "workspace_parse": true,
  "workspace_solve": true,
  "workspace_lock_parse": true,
  "workspace_lock_export": true,
  "workspace_lock_check": true,
  "workspace_lock_update": true,
  "workspace_lock_sbom": true,
  "export": true,
  "sbom": true,
  "verify": true,
  "sign": false
}

Inspect an invalid format response
HTTP 400

$ jq '{error, detail}' error.json
{
  "error": "Unknown format 'unknown-demo-format'; available: cdx-json, conda-lock, conda-lock-v1, conda-toml, conda-workspaces-lock, conda-workspaces-lock-v1, cyclonedx, cyclonedx-json, cyclonedx-json-v1.7, env.yml, environment-json, environment-yaml, explicit, json, pixi, pixi-lock-v6, pixi-toml, pyproject-toml, rattler-lock-v6, reqs, requirements, txt, workspace-lock, yaml, yml",
  "detail": null
}

Measure a resolve request and exact retained retrieval

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error --output result.json --dump-header headers.txt --write-out 'Resolve: %{time_total}s\n' 'http://127.0.0.1:57038/resolve?spec=zlib&channel=conda-forge&platform=linux-64'
Resolve: 0.401540s

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error --output retained.json --write-out 'Retained retrieval: %{time_total}s\n' http://127.0.0.1:57038/r/e08b81e283e9479632911eaa015fa8a6b91160559a98cc53910a0e35e1efa37a
Retained retrieval: 0.001968s

$ cmp result.json retained.json

These are local observations, not a service benchmark
